To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the nilpotent points of Calogero--Moser space for reflection type groups are parametrized by the two-sided cell of the group with parameters, and that the blocks of the restricted rational Cherednik algebra are parametrized naturally by the two sided cells of the group.

the nilpotent points of Calogero–Moser space for the reflection group G(m,1, n) are parametrised by two-sided cells of G(m,1, n) with unequal parameters, and that the blocks of reduced rational Cherednick algebras for these two-sided cells are described in terms of certain subspaces of the space of polynomials on G(m,1) n.
the Calogero-Mooser spaces of type A and type B are related to the reduced rational Cherednick algebra and the two-sided cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a geometric approach to the study of two-sided cells of complex reflection groups.
the geometry of CalogeroMoser spaces for reflection groups.
the geometry and representation theory of Calogero--Moser spaces, and in particular with the connection between the geometry and the representation theory of rational Cherednik algebra.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the nilpotent points of CM space for a complex reflection group are parametrised by the two-sided cell of the group with equal parameters, the blocks of the reduced rational Cherednick algebra are parametrised (in the case G(m,n,n) by the two-sided of the group with parameters, and that the blocks of the restricted Cherednick algebra for the group with unequal parameter are parametrised in type B by the two-sided for the group with parameters.
for any complex reflection group G the nilpotent points of CM space for G are parametrised by two-sided cells.
the two-sided cells are parametrised in a way that makes them the blocks of a certain family of Cherednik algebraq.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we show that the Calogero-Moserspace is a "geometrisation" of the two-sided cells in the case of G(m,1, n).
the Calogero-Mosser space is the space of "nilpotent blocks" of the rational Cherednik algebra.
the Calogero-Mosser spaces are "the spaces for two-sided cells" in the sense of the work of Lusztig and Spaltenstein.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the two-sided cells are in some sense the "nilpotency classes" of the reduced rational Cheredniki.
the two-sided cells are in bijection with the "nilpotency classes" of the Calogero-Moster space for reflection groups, which are parametrized by certain partitions of the Coxeter number of the group.
the geometry and combinatorics of CalogeroMoser spaces are intimately related to the combinatorics and representation theory of two-sided cells in Hecke algebras and Cherednik algeras.
